instructions: Move an oven rack to the top position and turn the broiler to high.
Lay the 8 slices of bread on a large baking sheet. Use two sheets if they don't fit in one layer.
Stir the sugar and cinnamon together in a small bowl.
Slice the butter as thin as you can and lay it over one side of each slice, right out to the edges. Softened butter works too if you spread it.
Sprinkle about 1 1/2 tsp of the cinnamon sugar over each slice.
Broil for 2 to 3 minutes, until the sugar bubbles and turns golden. Stay by the oven. It goes from golden to burnt fast.
Let the toast cool for 1 minute, then serve.
method_notes: Girl Versus Dough's broiler method is the lead (5.0 from 2 ratings, so below the 20 rating bar). Joy of Baking and Baking Mischief agree on butter, cinnamon sugar and a short broil. Cinnamon is raised to 2 tsp for 8 slices to match the usual 1/4 cup sugar to 2 1/4 tsp ratio. The list's 'two ingredients' is really four: bread, butter, sugar and cinnamon.
